modules.name: EncoderChannel

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.description: Top synchronizes release for child modules

behavior: Two-stage input synchronizer; whole AB candidate stable for 2500 cycles before accepting.
First stable phase initializes baseline without counting. Positive Gray order 00,01,11,10,00.
Counters wrap modulo 65536. Invalid diagonal transition increments invalid and resynchronizes.
constraints: C_REPORT_CYCLES must exceed full five-line UART transmission for every interval to be serviced.
AB voltage must be compatible with 3.3V IO. Mechanical CW polarity is not yet calibrated.
corner_cases: Initial stable phase must not generate a rotation.
Reset aborts UART and clears all counters.
Double-bit transition is rejected from position, not reconstructed.
verification_cases: xsim positive, negative, short glitch, backtracking bounce, invalid transition, five-channel mapping, exact ASCII and reset during UART.
Gowin synthesis and timing; hardware rotate test still required.

modules.name: EncoderUartTx

ports.name: i_start
ports.description: Start pulse accepted only when idle

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.description: Top synchronizes release for child modules

behavior: Latch start plus data plus stop when idle. Transmit LSB first, each bit lasts C_BAUD_CYCLES.
Ignore start while busy. Reset aborts transfer and forces idle high.

modules.name: EncoderDebug

ports.name: i_encoder_a
ports.description: Five A pins in board order

ports.name: i_encoder_b
ports.description: Five B pins in board order

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.description: Top synchronizes release for child modules

behavior: Synchronize reset release; instantiate five independent channels.
Every 100ms send five 34-byte ASCII lines; every line has one coherent snapshot.
Format: E1 A3 F3 Q0000 P0000 N0000 X0000 CR LF. Input sampling continues during output.
